title: The twelve-word type counts as hintWords does and rejects a long ternary branch
body:
## Summary
TwelveWords let a union label through and split on single spaces only.

## Description
packages/ui/src/components/hint/words.ts:19 read `OverTwelve<S> extends true`; a union's OverTwelve is boolean, so a ternary Empty label with a 13-word branch compiled, and check:narration never reads Empty. Newline/tab-joined 13 words compiled; a double-spaced twelve was rejected while hintWords said 12.

## Flow
- probe: 14 literal kinds through tsc on HEAD vs fix
- fix: `true extends OverTwelve<S>`, whitespace collapsed before counting
- law.test.ts case seeded red on HEAD (6 TS errors)

## Expected impact
A paragraph can no longer reach Empty or Hint as a ternary branch. Could break: a caller with an over-long branch (typecheck: 0).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - type and runtime counter agree
Before: 5 of 14 cases wrong
After: 0 of 14
Method: gate - law.test.ts under tsc -b packages/ui, red then green
Result: better
Gate: policy-tighten
evidence: packages/ui/src/components/hint/words.ts:19 (HEAD) `OverTwelve<S> extends true`; packages/ui/src/components/empty/Empty.tsx:8 uses TwelveWords; pipeline/check-narration.mjs:220 hintBodies reads <Hint only

## Description

After: 7 of 7 on 5 of 5 (lowest rose 3.22, Ghost 3.16 on ink-4)

title: StaleBadge's status region is mounted while live, so going stale is spoken
body:
## Summary
StaleBadge mounted its role=status region together with its words, so it announced nowhere.

## Description
packages/ui/src/components/stalebadge/StaleBadge.tsx:24 returned null while live; the repo's rule (tests/golden-path/announcement.probe.spec.ts:255 MOUNT EMPTY; registry accessibility/live-region-architecture: the region must exist before the news) was held for the announcer and not for this badge. Callers: app/(studio)/floor/_floor/Floor.tsx:188, app/(studio)/ledger/_ledger/Toolbar.tsx:126, app/(studio)/projects/runs/_runs/Runs.tsx:339.

## Flow
- feed goes quiet -> region inserted with `stale 42 s` -> no announcement
- fix: empty region in the sr-only box while live; stale fills the same element

## Expected impact
A screen-reader user hears a feed go stale. Could break: a live spec counting role=status unfiltered (none found).

## Evaluation
Claim: user - stale is spoken
Before: 0 of 3 edges share one region (live renders nothing)
After: 3 of 3
Method: gate - ledger.test.ts red on HEAD, green after
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: ledger.test.ts:203 old `toBe("")` pinned the defect; existing mutant stale-badge-shows-when-live re-pointed

title: A closed Hint/Tip tip stays in the accessibility tree behind opacity 0
instrument: hint-tap harness (tests/golden-path/hint-tap.probe.spec.ts): closed -> getByRole('tooltip') count 0 AND button toHaveAccessibleDescription(text); open -> visible; seed by removing visibility:hidden
body:
## Summary
The closed tip is hidden by opacity only, so browse mode reads every Hint's text as stray content after its glyph.

## Description
packages/ui/src/components/hint/Hint.module.css:6 `.tip{opacity:0;pointer-events:none}`; registry accessibility/hidden-but-mounted-inertness: opacity closes the visual channel only. The registry map already records it as a deviation (.ai/registry-map.json, accessibility, evaluated 2026-10-19). Fix: `visibility:hidden` when closed (a hidden node referenced by aria-describedby is still its description), transition visibility with opacity. tests/golden-path/hint-tap.probe.spec.ts:67 and tests/live/kit.live.spec.ts locate the tip by role, so they need the hidden option.

## Flow
- screen reader browse mode over a row with a Hint -> reads `? local GPU runs $0` twice (glyph description + stray tip)
- build: CSS + probe locator, then measure

## Expected impact
Each Hint's text is heard once, as the glyph's description. Could break: probes that find the closed tip by role.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - no duplicate reading
Before: closed tip present in the a11y tree (CSS: opacity only)
After: absent, description intact (predicted)
Method: simulation - needs a browser; the harness exists but its locator must change, and live specs cannot run here
Result: better
Gate: none

title: CapsHeading reads 4.13:1 on the Compose pop's ink-4 ground
instrument: marks-floor.test.ts text case: CapsHeading --faint over --ink-4 (4.13) with the caller's override token; out-of-scope: packages/ui/src/components/produce/Compose.module.css
body:
## Summary
The Compose pop draws a faint CapsHeading on --ink-4, under the 4.5:1 text floor.

## Description
packages/ui/src/components/heading/CapsHeading.module.css:3 color var(--faint); packages/ui/src/components/produce/ComposeDialog.tsx:84 `<CapsHeading text="compose" />` inside .pop (Compose.module.css:5, background --ink-4), whose own header says faint reads under 4.5:1 there and moved its captions to muted - the heading was missed. Fix: `.caps{color:var(--caps-ink,var(--faint))}` and `.pop,.inPlace{--caps-ink:var(--muted)}`.

## Flow
- open Compose -> `COMPOSE` heading at 4.13:1

## Expected impact
The pop's heading passes the text floor. Could break: nothing outside the pop.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - text floor
Before: 4.13:1 (faint #7a8398 on ink-4 #1d2331)
After: muted on ink-4 >= 4.5 (probe: muted text 5.86 even over chip wash)
Method: probe - token arithmetic; the fix's site is the produce context's stylesheet
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: scratch contrast probe: CapsHeading text --faint ink-4 4.13 (floor 4.5); Compose.module.css:1-4 comment

title: Empty mounts its role=status region with its label, so it is never announced
instrument: render test (packages/ui/test) + live audit of the 65 <Empty> sites: which empties are news (a filter emptying a list) vs a resting state; announce the former through lib/announcer
body:
## Summary
Every Empty is a live region that arrives with its words, the same silent shape StaleBadge had.

## Description
packages/ui/src/components/empty/Empty.tsx:12 `role="status"` mounted with `label`; 65 call sites. Either drop the role (a resting empty is not news) or announce the transition through the announcer.

## Flow
- filter a list to nothing -> Empty mounts with `no events match` -> nothing announced

## Expected impact
Filter results are spoken, or the inert regions are gone. Could break: live specs filtering getByRole('status').

## Evaluation
Claim: user - announce transitions
Before: 65 sites, region mounted with content
After: 0 (predicted)
Method: simulation - which empties are news is a per-site call over 65 callers
Result: better
Gate: none

title: A static ErrorLine speaks its message but not that it is an error
instrument: signal.test.ts: accessible text of a non-live ErrorLine contains an sr-only `error` before the verbatim message; live specs toContainText (audio-desk:193,208, audio-hunt:237) stay green
body:
## Summary
Without `live`, an ErrorLine's error state is a rose wash and an aria-hidden glyph only.

## Description
packages/ui/src/components/errorline/ErrorLine.tsx:11 Glyph warn is aria-hidden and the span has no role; SrOnly.tsx:1 states every drawn state has a spoken equivalent. Messages are `takes: <error>` etc. (app/(studio)/audio/_audio/Arrange.tsx:264), so a reader hears `takes: ENOENT` with nothing marking it failed.

## Flow
- screen reader reads a lane with a failed source -> hears the message as ordinary text

## Expected impact
The error state is heard. Could break: exact-text assertions over 108 call sites.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - state spoken
Before: 0 of 108 static sites speak the error state
After: 108 of 108 (predicted)
Method: simulation - 108 callers' text, live lane needed
Result: better
Gate: none

title: A Hint's tip runs off a phone screen when its glyph sits near the edge
instrument: hint-tap harness at a 375px viewport with the glyph 40px from the right edge: assert tip boundingBox within [0, innerWidth]
body:
## Summary
The Hint tip is centred on its glyph with a 260px max width and no edge clamp.

## Description
packages/ui/src/components/hint/Hint.module.css:6 left:50% translateX(-50%) max-width 260px; Hint always passes `centered` (Hint.tsx:35). A glyph within 130px of a 375px viewport's edge pushes the tip off-screen and adds horizontal scroll.

## Flow
- 375px, glyph at x=335 -> tip spans 205..465

## Expected impact
Disclosures stay readable on a phone. Could break: desktop placement if the clamp is unconditional.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - viewport fit
Before: tip right edge ~465px on a 375px screen (geometry)
After: within the viewport (predicted)
Method: simulation - geometry walked; needs the browser harness
Result: better
Gate: none
